bills.title: Fair Work Amendment (Repeal of 4 Yearly Reviews and Other Measures) Bill 2017

name: The majority voted against a [motion](http://www.openaustralia.org.au/debates/?id=2017-12-04.119.2) introduced by Labor MP [Tony Burke](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/watson/tony_burke), which called for the amendments to the bill to be considered immediately. He moved this motion after Liberal MP [Christopher Pyne](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/sturt/christopher_pyne) moved "*That the amendments be considered at the next sitting.*"
